text:
Predicates:
Japanese(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
Sells(x, y) ::: x sells y copies.
Selected(x) ::: x is selected into the Top 10 list.
Premises:
Japanese(company) ∧ Created(company, legendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Top10(x) → ∃y (Japanese(y) ∧ Created(y, x))) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (Sells(x, moreThanOneMillion) → Selected(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be selected into the Top 10 list.
Sells(legendOfZelda, moreThanOneMillion) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
∃x (Japanese(x) ∧ Created(x, fifa22)) ::: FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
